planets.name: Work
planets.description: Software I've shipped — legal-tech AI, housing SaaS, comic certification. Built across micro-frontends, Python backends, and .NET services.

constellation.label: LPA Extractor
constellation.detail: RAG-powered legal document extraction. Python + LangChain + Snowflake pipeline that cut LPA review time from 6 hours to 1. Deployed at BlackRock.

constellation.label: Term Intelligence
constellation.detail: Fund term analysis platform replacing a PowerBI prototype. React + FastAPI + GraphQL. Real-time comparison across 1,000+ private market funds.

constellation.label: Contact Profiles
constellation.detail: Micro-frontend contact system spanning 6+ services via Module Federation. .NET backend with SharePoint, MongoDB, and Snowflake integration.

constellation.label: AI Dev Workflows
constellation.detail: Adapted BlackRock's BreadKit AI framework for Preqin. Built 8+ reusable workflows — /dev-deploy, /pr-review, /save-investigation. Custom Atlassian MCP integration from scratch.

constellation.label: Housing Repairs SaaS
constellation.detail: Made Tech's first SaaS product for UK local councils. GOV.UK Design System. Django + React. Live in production across multiple boroughs.

constellation.label: Hackney Social Care
constellation.detail: Emergency restoration of Hackney Council's social care systems after a major cyberattack. Vulnerable adults and children depended on this service.

constellation.label: EGC Comic Certifier
constellation.detail: Full grading management system for CGC Comics Italy. Barcode scanning → grading workflow → certification. React 19 + FastAPI + PostgreSQL. €5,000+ freelance project.

planets.name: Craft
planets.description: Things I build with my hands — custom PCBs, ESP32 devices, reactive LED installations, and festival tech. From schematic to solder.

constellation.label: EsPoi — LED Poi
constellation.detail: Custom ESP32 LED juggling prop. Gyro + accelerometer reactive effects. Custom PCB designed in EasyEDA, BLE control, POV animations. Open source.

constellation.label: BMO
constellation.detail: Desktop AI companion. ESP32 hardware running GPT conversations, Spotify control, OLED facial expressions, RAG knowledge base, and a macOS menu bar app.

constellation.label: Reactive Bus Installation
constellation.detail: Multi-sensory AV across two double-decker buses — 4 unique environments. LED acrylic pipes, cloud ceiling, UV neon, starry night grid. PIR → Raspberry Pi → Arduino → LEDs + audio. £900 budget.

constellation.label: Burning Tech
constellation.detail: On-site tech tent for Burning Mountain Festival. Centralized LED prop configuration, performer troubleshooting, live logo display, juggler support point.

constellation.label: Custom PCB Design
constellation.detail: End-to-end PCB workflow. EasyEDA schematic + layout, 0603 SMD hand assembly with hot air, BOM cost reduction of 40–60%. BQ24074 + MT3608 + AP2112K power stack.

constellation.label: Addressable LEDs
constellation.detail: APA102 / SK9822 reactive lighting systems. Gyro and audio-driven patterns, BLE wireless control, OTA firmware updates, power-efficient animation engine.

planets.name: Music
planets.description: Music production & audio engineering — psytrance albums, VST plugin development, and live performance with Ableton Push.

constellation.label: The Cloud
constellation.detail: 6-track psytrance album as Jack Sonagli. Featuring collaborations with Psyranga and The Bad Fucoz. Tracks incl. Tunnel Vision, Sea of Clouds, r̴̂͜i̴̗̊t̶̮͈́͠u̶̞̓͒a̶̳͖͝l̸͍͎̃.

constellation.label: Remixed
constellation.detail: 5-track remix album for Bob Warley and the Haters. Genre-spanning electronic reworks with full stem production.

constellation.label: OctoBits and Pieces
constellation.detail: 9 experimental electronic tracks. Genre-hopping from chiptune to ambient. A playground for sound design and unconventional arrangements.

constellation.label: DnaVST
constellation.detail: Real-time 3D DNA helix that reacts to incoming audio. Built with C++ and JUCE. Audio feature extraction drives helix twist, base pair colors, and camera movement.

constellation.label: Ableton Live Set
constellation.detail: Live performance on Ableton Push. Tracks rebuilt from Arrangement to Session View with custom scene mapping, MIDI assignments, and performance-ready clip launching.

constellation.label: Audio Production
constellation.detail: Diploma in Audio Engineering from Nuova Audio Multimedia, Milan. Sound design, studio mixing, mastering — the foundation behind every music project here.

planets.name: Play
planets.description: Experiments & side quests — LLM slime colonies, fermentation labs, mushroom cultivation, and the occasional biotech proposal.

constellation.label: SlimeChan
constellation.detail: Interactive web colony where every slime has a distinct LLM-powered personality. Chat, feed, and watch them interact. React + AI APIs. Live at slimechan.xyz.

constellation.label: Obsidian Productivity OS
constellation.detail: ADHD-informed productivity system. Live DataviewJS dashboards for Jira, Bitbucket & TeamCity. Automated daily logs via AI. 7+ custom AI workflows. Built on years of neurodiversity research and self-experimentation.

constellation.label: JackDir
constellation.detail: Open-source CLI for packaging codebase context for LLMs. Extracts directory trees, file contents, and metadata into shareable snapshots. My daily driver for AI-assisted development.

constellation.label: BioSwitch
constellation.detail: Biotech startup MVP. Full statement of work, system architecture diagram, prototype plan, and commercial proposal. Exploring the software–biology interface.

constellation.label: Mushroom Cultivation
constellation.detail: Home mycology lab. Agar plate inoculation, Still Air Box construction, substrate preparation. Active strain selection and vendor research for gourmet mushrooms.

constellation.label: Ginger Bug Lab
constellation.detail: Wild fermentation with ginger bug starter. Flavour trials across lemon, orange, grapefruit + lime, and chamomile. Fully documented process from zero to bottle.
